title: SIDESTORY: DOROTHY'S VISION OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: DOROTHY'S VISION OPEN
DURATION: March 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 4, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Dorothy's Vision event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGES DURATION: Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
- [Test Site] Duration: March 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Rhine HQ] Duration: March 21, 2023, 16:00 (UTC-7) - March 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[DATA COLLECTION]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Data Collection] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Astgenne, Rhine Experimental Culture Pod Furniture (Pieces), Mysterious Reagents.
[LABORATORY RECYCLING DEPOT]
DURATION: March 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 4, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, you can collect [Mysterious Reagents] by participating the event and use them to redeem items as rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Astgenne's Token, Rhine Experimental Culture Pod Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, and more.
NOTE:
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN - PATHFINDER OF SANDS
DURATION: March 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Pathfinder of Sands], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Dorothy
★★★★★: Greyy the Lightningbearer / Ptilopsis
03 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game.
★★★★★★: Dorothy
★★★★★: Greyy the Lightningbearer
★★★★★: Astgenne
NOTE:
- Operator Astgenne is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Dorothy's Vision, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
- Operator Dorothy and Greyy the Lightningbearer will be permanently added to other Headhuntings in future update.
- Operator Dorothy, Greyy the Lightningbearer, and Astgenne will gain more trust in the event stages.
04 CORAL COAST COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: March 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Coral Coast Collection - Shimmering Dew SD08 for Carnelian
Coral Coast Collection - Casual Vacation HDm04 for Flamebringer
Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flower FA641 for Blacknight
05 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: March 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Weißer Sand for Beeswax
EPOQUE Collection - Londinium Style Miko for Tsukinogi
EPOQUE Collection - Leisurely Afternoon for Perfumer
06 NEW FURNITURE SET – RHINE EXPERIMENTAL CULTURE POD
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Rhine Experimental Culture Pod, will be available during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Dorothy’s Vision event rewards and redeem in Laboratory Recycling Depot (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces) from March 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) to March 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
07 CHIP PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DURATION: March 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
[PATHFINDER OF SANDS CHIP PACK]
CONTENTS: Specialist Chip Pack * 8, Specialist Chip * 5, LMD * 210000
